headline: US bitcoin funds lost $453 million on Wednesday, their seventh straight day of outflows, while bitcoin sits near $60,000 on the US Thanksgiving holiday ahead of Friday's monthly options expiry.

market.asOf: BTC and ETH from Investing.com at 06:18 UTC Thu 26 Nov (13:18 Bangkok); SOL from CoinMarketCap about 08:00 UTC. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: 9 on CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index and 13 on Alternative.me's index, both read about 08:00 UTC.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds lose $453 million on Wednesday, the seventh outflow day in a row
stories.summary: Money has now left US spot bitcoin funds for seven days in a row, even as the price bounced.
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $453.12 million on Wed 25 Nov, per SoSoValue data reported by TokenPost; Farside's count, reported by Bloomingbit, also shows about $453 million.
BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $329.71 million of the outflow; of the 12 funds, seven recorded outflows, per TokenPost.
November outflows reached about $4.94 billion through Tuesday, per SoSoValue data cited by The Block, before Wednesday's figure.
US funds do not trade today for Thanksgiving, so the next daily figure comes after Friday's session.

The Block: Swiss bitcoin ETF begins trading (November flows)

stories.title: Tariff plan, hot inflation and pricier oil keep pressure on crypto as bitcoin holds near $60,000
stories.summary: A formal US plan for new tariffs on 14 economies, inflation above forecasts and rising oil prices are weighing on markets. Bitcoin is back near $60,000 but is having a very weak month.
points: Bitcoin was at $60,397.8 at 06:18 UTC on Thursday, up 2%, per Investing.com.
Bitcoin is down 24% in November and on pace for its worst month since June 2022, per Bitbo.
The US proposed extra tariffs on 14 trading partners; comments are due 5 January 2027 and hearings start 25 January, per Bitbo.
Brent crude was at $94.71 a barrel at 06:40 GMT Thursday after Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, per Unbiased Headlines.

sources.label: Bitbo: bitcoin sinks on tariff proposal
Unbiased Headlines: Brent rises for a third day

stories.title: A bitcoin reserve bill can now get a House vote, but betting markets give it little chance this year
stories.summary: A bill to write a US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law is on the House calendar, with little time left before Congress breaks.
points: H.R. 8957, the American Reserve Modernization Act from Rep. Nick Begich, was sent to the full House on 24 Nov after the House Financial Services Committee approved it 28-21, per The Block.
The bill would bar any sale of reserve bitcoin for at least 20 years, per The Block.
Polymarket's odds of a national bitcoin reserve by year-end were 4%, down from 34% in May, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: House committee advances strategic bitcoin reserve bill

briefs.title: Hackers divert bitcoin miners' computing power
briefs.summary: Mining pool Braiins found an attack that redirects miners' computing power through unencrypted connections; more than 1,000 mining sites were targeted on 20 Nov, per The Block.

briefs.title: A spot bitcoin ETF starts trading in Switzerland
briefs.summary: BIT's BBIT has begun trading on the SIX exchange holding 350 BTC, with a 0.19% yearly fee, per The Block.

briefs.title: Fidelity files for a spot Chainlink fund
briefs.summary: Fidelity filed to list a spot Chainlink (LINK) fund on Nasdaq under the ticker FLNK; it will not stake its LINK, per The Block.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed Vice Chair Bowman testifies
calendar.note: ISM: consensus 55 per Nowflation, while Wells Fargo forecasts 53.8; October was 55.5. JOLTS: consensus 7.3 million per Nowflation, September 7.52 million. Bowman appears before the House Financial Services Committee, per the Fed's calendar.
October was +86,000, per Nowflation. No published consensus found.
October was 54.5, per InvestingLive. Weekly jobless claims come out the same day at 8:30am ET; last week's figure was 189,000.

Forecasts differ: consensus +82,000 jobs and 4.2% unemployment per Nowflation; U.S. Bank's consensus is +101,000 jobs and Wells Fargo expects +80,000. October payrolls rose 165,000 with unemployment at 4.1%, per the BLS.
Markets expect a rate hike, not a cut. CME FedWatch put the chance of a quarter-point hike at 97.8% on 25 Nov, per KuCoin News.
